_schema: route → iOS tap-path + expected accessibility element list. Filled by the ios-visual-parity bootstrap (ios_ref_capture.sh).
_note_ios: iOS tapPath items are either a bare accessibility label (e.g. "Settings") — ios_ref_capture.sh tap-label finds it in describe-all and taps its centre — or a raw "x,y" point coordinate (for the tap command). The prefixed id:/text:/desc: form belongs to the Android ledger only.
